newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APEC feels Taiwan should be in WTO, says official.
newsitem.headline: APEC feels Taiwan should be in WTO, says official.

text.p: The 18-member Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum believes Taiwan should be eligible for membership in the World Trade Organisation (WTO), a top Philippines' official said on Thursday.

Answering a question on admitting Taiwan to the WTO, Philippines undersecretary for foreign affairs Federico Macaranas told an APEC news briefing the issue had been discussed previously at meetings of the Pacific Rim group.
"There was consensus that there should be a totality of trade in the WTO. The inclusion of more members to universalise the WTO's process is one that APEC has long recognised," he said.
Neither China nor Taiwan is currently a member of the WTO, the the new world trade forum which holds its first ministerial conference in Singapore next month.
Both are members of APEC, in which Taiwan is designated "Chinese Taipei".
APEC is holding its annual meeting in the Philippines. culminating with a summit of leaders at Subic Bay next Monday.
